title: Berezin-Toeplitz Quantization of non-compact manifolds
summary: We develop Berezin-Toeplitz quantization in a non-compact complex geometric setting. Let $(X,Θ)$ be a Hermitian manifold, $(L,h^L)$ a positive holomorphic line bundle, and $(E,h^E)$ a holomorphic Hermitian vector bundle. Assuming that the Kodaira Laplacian on $(0,1)$-forms with values in $L^p\!\otimes E$ has a spectral gap growing linearly in $p$, we prove that the Bergman projection onto the $L^2$-holomorphic space $H^0_{(2)}(X,L^p\!\otimes E)$ enjoys the usual off-diagonal decay and admits a full asymptotic expansion on compact subsets as $p\to\infty$.
